say:1:1410412001:0.text: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?
say:1:1410412001:0.source_cn: 肮脏的仆从，竟敢直视我的眼睛！
say:1:1410412001:0.male: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?
say:1:1410412001:0.female: Filthy wretch, how dare you meet my gaze?

say:2:1410412002:0.text: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
say:2:1410412002:0.source_cn: 谁允许你在这里游荡？你的主人是谁？
say:2:1410412002:0.male: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
say:2:1410412002:0.female: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?

choice_prompt:3:1410412002.text: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.source_cn: 谁允许你在这里游荡？你的主人是谁？
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.male: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?
choice_prompt:3:1410412002.female: Who gave you leave to wander? Who do you serve?

say:4:1410412003:0.source_cn: 哼，原来是无主的仆从啊……

say:5:1410412005:0.text: Still... you carry yourself unlike the rest of these dogs. So—
say:5:1410412005:0.source_cn: 不过……你的举止可不像个普通的仆从啊。那么——
say:5:1410412005:0.male: Still... you carry yourself unlike the rest of these dogs. So—
say:5:1410412005:0.female: Still... you carry yourself unlike the rest of these dogs. So—

say:6:1410412006:0.text: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...
say:6:1410412006:0.source_cn: 你，去给我取一份恩典灵露来！如果你做不到……
say:6:1410412006:0.male: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...
say:6:1410412006:0.female: Fetch me a dram of Divine Dew. And if you fail...

say:7:1410412007:0.text: I'll brand you with the Stigma of Judgment myself. But if you succeed...
say:7:1410412007:0.source_cn: 你就等着接受惩罚印记吧！当然，如果你能做到的话……
say:7:1410412007:0.male: I'll brand you with the Stigma of Judgment myself. But if you succeed...
say:7:1410412007:0.female: I'll brand you with the Stigma of Judgment myself. But if you succeed...

say:8:1410412008:0.text: I might graciously replace this useless fool with you.
say:8:1410412008:0.source_cn: 那我就大发慈悲地用你替换掉这个废物，收你做我的仆从！
say:8:1410412008:0.male: I might graciously replace this useless fool with you.
say:8:1410412008:0.female: I might graciously replace this useless fool with you.

say:10:1410412009:0.text: Noble master, please! I-I'll fetch it right away, just don't cast me aside!
say:10:1410412009:0.source_cn: 尊贵的主人，求你三思！我现在就去办，不要换掉我！

say:11:1410412010:0.text: Your clumsiness bores me, Aven. It's time for a new toy.
say:11:1410412010:0.source_cn: 我已经厌烦你的笨拙了，是时候换个新玩具了。

choice_prompt:12:1410412010.text: Your clumsiness bores me, Aven. It's time for a new toy.
choice_prompt:12:1410412010.source_cn: 我已经厌烦你的笨拙了，是时候换个新玩具了。

say:13:1410412011:0.source_cn: 快去，别浪费我宝贵的时间！

say:15:1410412012:0.text: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize him!
say:15:1410412012:0.source_cn: 你竟敢如此对我说话！卫队，给我抓住<male>他</m...
say:15:1410412012:0.male: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize him!
say:15:1410412012:0.female: How dare you speak to me like that?! Guards, seize her!

choice:12:1:2.text: I don't have time to waste.
choice:12:1:2.male: I don't have time to waste.
choice:12:1:2.female: I don't have time to waste.

say:16:1410412004:0.text: Hah! A mission? Probably some lowly noble's errand.
say:16:1410412004:0.source_cn: 嗤，秘密任务？怕是哪个末流小贵族家的吧。
say:16:1410412004:0.male: Hah! A mission? Probably some lowly noble's errand.
say:16:1410412004:0.female: Hah! A mission? Probably some lowly noble's errand.

choice:3:1:2.text: I'm on a mission for my master.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 我在执行主人的秘密任务
choice:3:1:2.male: I'm on a mission for my master.
choice:3:1:2.female: I'm on a mission for my master.
